SHIPROCKET ACTIVATION IS DEFERRED BY THE OWNER

Leave SHIPPING_PROVIDER=none in commerce and worker environments until credentials
are supplied. Manual courier entry continues to work; no live booking is needed
to run the store or the automated tests.

The prepared adapter supports API-user login with single-flight token refresh,
or an already-issued bearer token through SHIPROCKET_API_TOKEN. A bearer token
expires and must be replaced; an API-user email/password pair supports refresh.
The dashboard never receives or stores either credential.

Activation steps when the owner supplies credentials:
1. Put SHIPPING_PROVIDER=shiprocket and SHIPROCKET_WEBHOOK_TOKEN in the private
   commerce and worker environments. Supply either the dedicated API user's
   SHIPROCKET_EMAIL and SHIPROCKET_PASSWORD or SHIPROCKET_API_TOKEN. Restart the
   two services. Do not change the read-only experience service environment.
2. Run pnpm shipping:readiness in backend/ with that environment loaded. This
   only reads pickup locations and wallet balance. It creates no shipment.
3. In dashboard Shipping settings choose the exact registered pickup location,
   pickup PIN, parcel defaults, courier rules and preferred couriers. Ensure
   every shippable variant has a weight and dimensions.
4. Configure the provider tracking webhook at
   https://<API_ORIGIN>/v1/webhooks/shiprocket with x-api-key matching
   SHIPROCKET_WEBHOOK_TOKEN. Use a separate random secret for this webhook.
5. Check one delivery PIN and an unavailable PIN through the shipping tools.
6. For a controlled real order, review courier quotes, wallet balance and COD
   value, then explicitly book from the dashboard. Verify AWB, label and pickup.
   If a request times out, reconcile by the same merchant reference before
   creating anything else; never blindly replay a create request.
7. Verify webhook deduplication and the same tracking status on dashboard, web
   and app. Verify cancellation before pickup and a provider outage.
8. The reverse adapter uses the documented return endpoint, buyer pickup
   address, merchant drop address, selected immutable order lines and package
   dimensions. It is not auto-booked by approving a return: reverse booking
   must pass its own merchant review and live acceptance when the account is
   available. Manual return coordination remains the operational fallback.

No real-provider acceptance has been claimed without credentials. Official API:
https://apidocs.shiprocket.in/?version=latest
